from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque
\ndef transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    template = max(comps, key=len)
    tr0, tr1 = min(p[0] for p in template), max(p[0] for p in template)
    tc0, tc1 = min(p[1] for p in template), max(p[1] for p in template)
    anchor = ((tr0 + tr1) // 2, (tc0 + tc1) // 2)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp is template:
            continue
        for r, c, _ in comp:
            out[r][c] = bg
            for y, x, color in template:
                yy, xx = r + y - anchor[0], c + x - anchor[1]
                if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                    out[yy][xx] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-37a5f145.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
